faq.empty: No FAQ items for this page.
faq.q1: How does the pity system work?
faq.a1: 5-stars are guaranteed within 70 pulls. 4-stars are guaranteed within 10 pulls. Your pity counter is shared across all pulls on the same banner.
faq.a2: On limited banners, you have a 50% chance of pulling the featured character. If you lose the 50/50, your next 5-star on that banner is guaranteed to be the featured character.
faq.a3: Precise Wish lets you designate a target Love Interest. If you lose the 50/50, your next guaranteed 5-star will always be from your chosen Love Interest instead of a random one.
faq.q4: What are Deepspace Wish and Empyrean Wish tickets?
faq.a4: These are two different currency types. Deepspace Wishes are used for standard and limited banners, while Empyrean Wishes are used for the exclusive Empyrean banner. You can earn them from the Wishfall Frenzy arcade game.
faq.q5: How do I rank up memories?
faq.a5: Pulling duplicate cards automatically increases the rank (stars) of the memory. Higher ranks unlock additional bonuses.
faq.q6: How do I reset my data?
faq.a6: Open Settings → Reset Data → Confirm. This permanently deletes all pulls, pity, wishes, and your collection.
faq.q7: Is this affiliated with Infold Games or Papergames?
faq.a7: No. This is a completely unofficial fan-made project for entertainment purposes only. No copyright infringement is intended.

settings.info_p1: A fan-made, beautifully crafted wish (gacha) simulator for the game Love and Deepspace. Test your luck without spending real money!
settings.info_p2: This project aims to recreate the authentic summoning experience from the game, featuring dynamic animations, a pity system, character collections, and a gorgeous, responsive UI built entirely with vanilla web technologies.
settings.info_ack_desc: Thank you to Chey, Tasha, and Yuhina for helping me gather the missing memories in my collection.

Love and Deepspace, its characters, artwork, audio, and all associated intellectual property are the exclusive property of their respective copyright holders. This project is created strictly for entertainment and fan purposes, with no commercial intent. No copyright infringement is intended.
settings.priv_1_desc: We do not collect, store, transmit, or share any of your personal information. This web application operates entirely on the client side (within your web browser). We do not have servers that record your gameplay, activity, or personal data.
settings.priv_2_desc: To save your simulator progress (such as your pull history, pity count, memory collection, and audio settings), this site uses your browser's Local Storage. This data is stored strictly on your device and never leaves it. You can delete this data at any time by using the 'Reset Data' option in the Settings menu or by clearing your browser's cache and site data.
settings.priv_3_desc: The photobooth feature processes images locally on your device. Any photos you take, upload, or edit within the photobooth are never uploaded to our servers (because we don't have any). Everything stays on your phone or computer.
settings.priv_4_desc: This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. While the simulator itself tracks nothing, GitHub may automatically collect standard web server logs (such as IP addresses) for security and operational purposes. You can read more about this in the GitHub Privacy Statement.
settings.priv_5_desc: If you have any questions or concerns about this project, you can reach out via Discord, Github, Instagram, and X/Twitter.

faq.flames_a1: FLAMES stands for Friends, Love, Affection, Marriage, Enemies, Siblings. Each letter represents a possible relationship outcome between two people.
faq.flames_q2: How is the FLAMES result calculated?
faq.flames_a2: Enter two names. The shared letters are counted and eliminated alternately. The letter remaining at the end is your FLAMES result.
faq.flames_a3: FLAMES is a classic fortune-telling game for fun — it's not scientifically accurate! Take the result with a smile.
faq.flames_a4: The ticket is a shareable image of your FLAMES result, styled like a concert or lottery ticket. You can download it and share it with your friends!
faq.flames_a5: Yes! Click the "Again" button to reset and try a new pair of names.
faq.flames_q6: Can I change the names after calculating?
faq.flames_a6: Click "Again" to reset, then enter new names and calculate again.

faq.mash_a1: MASH stands for Mansion, Apartment, Shack, House. It's a classic fortune-telling game to predict your future life!
faq.mash_a2: Draw a spiral to determine your 'magic number', then the game goes through all options and eliminates every Nth option until one remains per category.
faq.mash_a3: Yes! Each category has default options, but you can edit them to make your personalized predictions.
faq.mash_a4: Each category represents a different aspect of your future — your home, job, partner, where you live, etc. It's all just for fun!
faq.mash_q5: Can I save or share my result?
faq.mash_a5: Yes! When the game finishes, use the share/download buttons to export your MASH result as an image.
faq.mash_a6: Yes! Click the Again button at the end to start a new round of eliminations with the same or different options.

pb.desc: Step into the cosmos and capture your celestial moments. Choose exclusive frames featuring your favorite Love and Deepspace companions and instantly print gorgeous, personalized memory strips.
pb.choose_layout_desc: How many frames will your strip have?
pb.decorate_desc: Add filters, stickers, and text to your photostrip
pb.capture_desc: Save your photostrip to your device or share it with the community.
faq.pb_q1: How do I start the photobooth?
faq.pb_a1: Select a frame from the banner list on the main screen, then click "Enter Photobooth" to begin your session.
faq.pb_a2: Each Love Interest has their own unique themed frame. You can preview each frame before entering the booth.
faq.pb_q3: Can I use my own photos?
faq.pb_a3: Yes! Inside the booth, tap the upload button in the camera controls to upload a photo from your device instead of using the live camera.
faq.pb_q4: How do I add stickers and filters?
faq.pb_a4: After capturing your photos, use the decoration panel on the right side to apply filters, add stickers, or add text overlays to your strip.
faq.pb_q5: How do I save my photostrip?
faq.pb_a5: On the export screen, click the download button to save your photostrip as an image file. You can also share it directly.
faq.pb_q6: Why is my camera not working?
faq.pb_a6: Make sure you have granted camera permissions to your browser. If using HTTPS is required, try accessing via localhost or a secure connection.
faq.pb_studio_a1: On the camera screen, position yourself and click the shutter button. The booth will automatically take a series of photos for your strip.
faq.pb_studio_a2: Use the back arrow on the camera screen to go back and retake. You can redo any shot before confirming the strip.
faq.pb_studio_a3: Switch to the Stickers tab in the right panel. Tap any sticker to place it on your strip, then drag and resize it as you like.
faq.pb_studio_a4: Open the Filters tab in the right panel and select a filter. The effect is instantly previewed on your strip.
faq.pb_studio_a5: Go to the Text tab, type your message, and place it on the strip. You can drag and resize text overlays.
faq.pb_studio_q6: How do I delete a sticker or text?
faq.pb_studio_a6: Select the decoration by tapping it, then use the red trash icon that appears on the top-left corner of the selected item.
faq.pb_studio_q7: How do I download my strip?
faq.pb_studio_a7: On the final export screen, click the download button. Your photostrip will be saved as a PNG image.
faq.pb_studio_q8: How do I print my strip?
faq.pb_studio_a8: After downloading, you can open the image and print it from your device. The strip is designed in a standard photostrip aspect ratio.
